scope.summary: Expose per-paragraph composer selection under Studio-native names: paragraph (default; evaluates all lines together weighting break points by letter-spacing/word-spacing/hyphenation penalties for even color), single_line (one line at a time, predictable manual break control), world_ready (complex-script-aware paragraph/single-line composition), cjk (CJK line-breaking with kinsoku/mojikumi). Source product names (Adobe Every-line/Single-line/World-Ready/Japanese composers) are never Studio names. Operator-selectable + model command.
expected_tests: live: composer switch changes break points deterministically per paragraph
argus: composer control exposes {paragraph,single_line,world_ready,cjk} with Studio-native names
acceptance_criteria_original: 4 Studio-native composers selectable per paragraph; deterministic breaks; GUI + model surface

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-TYP-010] Composer (line-break engine) selection is per-paragraph. Studio MUST expose, under Studio-native names, at minimum: | Studio composer (`composer`) | Behavior | Provenance | |---|---|---| | `paragraph` (default) | Evaluates all lines of the paragraph together, weighting break points by letter-spacing, word-spacing, and hyphenation penalties for even color | Adobe Paragraph / Every-line Composer | | `single_line` | Composes one line at a time for traditional, predictable manual break control | Adobe Single-line Composer | | `world_ready` | Complex-script (Arabic/Hebrew/Indic) shaping-aware paragraph/single-line composition | Adobe World-Ready Composers | | `cjk` | CJK line-breaking with kinsoku and mojikumi | Japanese Paragraph / Single-line Composers |

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.
